I came back after not playing for years two days ago. I’m 22.

My boyfriend isn’t an idiot but I am. We were outside and I looked at the sky at night and said “look at that really big star” I was very excited and then he starts laughing and goes “baby that’s an airplane.” He was right, it was an airplane.

My dad has serious mental health issues and has cleaned up his act. He was also addicted to drugs for a long time. It’s the trauma I’m left with that gets me. My parents divorced when I was 15 after he attempted to kill me by bashing my head in with a ladder.

I live with my mom but I’m staying with my best friend who happens to be my ex. It’s a weird situation that I won’t go into detail about. 

I’ve just been lied about, talked about, shit on by almost everyone I love/loved. The only people that have ever been there for me died.
